title: The regulatory framework for fish sorting measurements
description: Contains information about the regulating body and guidelines for conducting fish sorting measurements

jurisdiction.description: The jurisdiction under which the fish sorting measurement is conducted, e.g. EU, US, etc.

regulation_reference.description: The specific regulation or guideline reference that applies to the fish sorting measurement (eg. EU Reg 2019/1241)

minimum_landing_sizes.description: The minimum landing sizes for different fish species

items.description: The fish species and its minimum landing size

size.description: The minimum landing size for the species in meters

fish_species.description: The type of the product, e.g. a type of fish. This is a 3-letter FAO fish species code
